// diagnostic

E1251

Toolchain {channel} ({version}) isn't available for {platform}.

What

Toolchain {channel} ({version}) isn't available for {platform}.

Why

This project pins a Jet toolchain, but no prebuilt object for it was found for this platform. Jet realizes the pinned compiler as a prebuilt — it never builds the compiler from source and never silently falls back to a different `jet` (D-JPK-TOOLCHAIN1).

Fix

Move the pin with `jet update jet <channel>` to a toolchain your platform has, or install the pinned toolchain from the release page.
